A '''gem stall''' is a [[stall]], which may be stolen from at level 75 [[Thieving]], granting 408 Thieving [[experience]]. There is a respawn time of 60 seconds.

Thieving from the [[Green Gemstone Gems]] stall is a requirement for the [[Fremennik Diary|Fremennik Hard Diary]].

A [[Gem stall (Al Kharid)|gem stall]] can be found next to the [[Gem trader]] in [[Al Kharid]], but players cannot steal from it.

Stealing from a gem stall is worth {{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Gem stall|raw=y}}}} on average.

===Regular===
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1260210901434630145|date=12 May 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101774|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=Out of 128:
105 - sapphire
17 - emerald
5 - Ruby
1 - diamond}}

{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLineSkill|name=Uncut sapphire|quantity=1|rarity=105/128|skill=Thieving}}
{{DropsLineSkill|name=Uncut emerald|quantity=1|rarity=17/128|skill=Thieving}}
{{DropsLineSkill|name=Uncut ruby|quantity=1|rarity=5/128|skill=Thieving}}
{{DropsLineSkill|name=Uncut diamond|quantity=1|rarity=1/128|skill=Thieving}}
{{DropsTableBottom}}

Note that standard gem stalls do not drop [[dragonstone]] or [[onyx]]; these are only available from the [[Shop Counter (gems)|shop counter]] in [[Mor Ul Rek]].

==Trivia==
*A [[Gem stall (Sophanem)|variant]] of the gem stall was added in April 2005 that would have presumably appeared in [[Sophanem]], but is unused. A graphically updated version was also added with the release of [[Contact!]]
